reviews.text:
Visited after watching Big Face YouTube.

reviews.author: Experience Plus 1 (let's go until we get it)
reviews.text: I went there because I heard it was delicious in a YouTube advertisement video. It was an unbelievable video. First of all, it didn't taste good to me. And I didn't even spread cheese grilled in an oven like in the video. It just had a square piece of regular cheese in it. Of course I couldn't taste the flavor of the cheese. The fries were soaked in oil and were hard and oil-colored. It was the worst fries, to the point where I thought Lotteria's fries were much better. I threw it away without eating it all. It was also inconvenient to see that the trash disposal area was not as organized as it looked. I don't know how to throw away the leftover food (that's why I ate at least a few fries). The taste of the thick drink wasn't bad, but the burger made me crave carbonation. So a feeling of regret comes over me. Even though it was rush hour, I could understand why there were hardly any people there. It's very unpleasant. Other than the fact that I used it quietly and alone in a large space with no people around, it was okay. I almost got scolded if I went there on behalf of an acquaintance. It costs 20,000 nyang when ordering as shown in the photo. It's not cost-effective. I recommend other burger restaurants. Are you being deceived by the photo? Hahaha

A refreshing and rather delightful departure from the sea of cafés that dominate Seongsu. Overall, it's a birria taco that's not overly seasoned but has a solid flavor, so I think even first-time eaters can enjoy it without burden. It was a perfect menu to eat with beer.

reviews.author: Donggyu Oh
reviews.text:
Here, I ordered eggs Benedict and galette. First, I ate a galette.  The more I chewed the galette, the more confused my mind became. ‘Why is it so familiar?’ It was my first time seeing a menu called galette, but it tasted very familiar to me. That's not to say it doesn't taste good. I had some fun eating it. I came here expecting a new experience, but was just taken aback by the familiarity of kimchi stew. Actually, brunch is a type of Western home cooking, so maybe it should be considered in the same context...

The taste is like a less warm and refreshing pizza. Eggs, vegetables, bread, sliced ​​ham, and potatoes fill my mouth. However, rather than harmonizing the tastes, each person is noisy, like recess in middle school.  I think it feels that way because the temperature of the ingredients is different.

Eggs Benedict was even more embarrassing. Once again, the taste is definitely there... It was delicious, but so familiar. If the galette was like stir-fried pork, Eggs Benedict was like soybean paste stew. What it tastes like is the sweet egg sauce that covers the bread, while the salty bacon and sautéed onions add to the flavor. Can you remember what it tastes like? It will taste just as you imagine.

reviews.author: YennaPPa (Luscious.K)
reviews.text:
#Seongsu-dong #Herge

“I’m in love with Hergé Campagne.”

On the way to Seongsu Station, there was a small but very tasty bakery.
I have to go there someday... a place I've been meaning to visit.

But one day, I searched for places to eat bread in Seongsu-dong, and found that the restaurant was the most highly rated place in Seongsu.
I visited with a happy heart.

The breads I purchased were campagne, ciabatta, waffles, and croissants, and they were all very delicious.
These days, bakeries have become more and more standard, so most everything is delicious, but Hergé's Campagne is even more delicious.
The outside is rough enough to scratch the roof of your mouth, but the inside is infinitely soft and chewy.
The air bubbles caused by the presentation are visible and it feels like a well-made baguette.

I think I buy bread every time I go to Seongsu.

#Ruscious’s Best Bakery

reviews.author: TOBOTIBO
reviews.text:
Taste is a matter of preference and there is no right answer, so it is impossible to be certain.

Because there is a difference in economic structure from Japan, I do not want to make an absolute comparison based solely on the taste of the bread. The biggest difference between Japanese neighborhood bakeries and Korea is not only the quality of the bread, but also the service.

I found it by chance while passing by in front of Seongsu Station. I went in after seeing a review saying that the canelé and pistachio crust was delicious.

He stares at me blankly.. I also stare at him. I was afraid people might misunderstand that I was having a snowball fight, so I quickly turned my attention to the bread. Always remain silent both when paying and leaving. Is it aphasia?
thank god. As I see him walking around outside wearing work clothes while chatting, I don't think he's sick.

Looking at the price and visuals, you can get a rough idea of ​​what is important.

The overall price is high, but I think the only reason is to pay the high monthly rent and cover the labor costs of hiring part-time workers without a service mind.

The training to put the store's name, Herge, on the bread in large letters is thorough. If you stay still, you can do the basics.

Ask for a receipt.
Oh, would you like it? I ask again..! It wasn't aphasia.

I was able to experience the feeling of being in an unmanned bakery at a place that sells pastries for 6,000 to 7,000 won.

The canelé is baked until it is crispy like a hard cookie. I think it burned more than necessary during the second grilling process. Why does this cost 4,000 won? It's big!

Suddenly, I wish that small businesses that focus on bread and those who do business faithfully in the neighborhood would become more prosperous and more numerous.

reviews.text: Seongsu-dong is famous for its many talented bakeries, but it is the most popular bakery among them. It is rare to find a bakery that serves almost all types of bread, from basic breads such as baguettes, ciabatta, and campagne to puffed curry, baked snacks, salt bread, and jambon beurre. It is a bakery that gives you above-average satisfaction with any bread you buy, so in a word, it is considered the department store of the bakery world. The store is small and there is a wait, but I think it is worth it. I think it is also a good idea to use the Apgujeong branch because it is relatively quiet.

reviews.text:
This review is based on my experience visiting last year.

Hergé Seongsu: A sourdough and pastry takeout restaurant with an area of ​​approximately 20 pyeong. They say they aim to use organic flour and good ingredients.
1. Soft Jambon Beurre: A sandwich made with sourdough campagne.  I liked the savory taste and aroma from the unique crumb of sourdough, and the balance between the subtle acidity and light taste of the sourdough bread, the lightly spread whole grain mustard, the not-salty jambon, and the fermented butter sprinkled with pepper was really good. It felt a bit expensive, but the taste gave me satisfaction.
2. Fig Campagne: Round Campagne. It looked like there were a lot of dried figs stuck in it, but when I cut the cross section, they were only stuck on the outside. Because it was a product with fillings, the pores were dense. I liked the unique acidity of sourdough and the sweetness of dried figs, but the bread was thick and there was no fig filling in the middle, so I only felt the sourness, which was a bit disappointing. It would have been nice if the fig filling was evenly spread across the bread.
3. Plain Croissant: It had a better, nutty buttery flavor than Teni’s croissant, and it wasn’t as matte. The croissant was quite large in volume.

#Seongsu-dong #Seongsu Station #Fishcake Country

“A small paradise in Seongsu Station, the hell of commuting”

The oden restaurant in the crowded subway is a little paradise.
There is one at every station with many pedestrians, and each has its own characteristics.
Eomuknara, an oden restaurant in Seongsu Station, sells delicious fish cakes, tteokbokki, sundae, and toast, so the variety is quite good.

First of all, I like the variety of this house.
Just having toast sets it apart from other restaurants.
The breakfast menu includes kimbap and toast, but Seongsu Station is the first time I tried toast at a subway station.
(I haven’t tried it, so I don’t know the taste haha)

I also eat a lot of sundae and tteokbokki.
People eat more sundae because it is delicious, and if you ask for tteokbokki soup with sundae, they are kind enough to add a few rice cakes to the dish.
You can also make skewers in order. With spicy seasoning.
He started eating sundae and sundae skewers a lot in the morning.

I think the best rice is oden.
It is a well-drained soup that is quite refreshing and savory, and has a very slight spiciness, so anyone will enjoy it.

The oden eating system is really good.
Instead of eating with the soup splashing around, you take a plastic plate and eat it while holding it on it.
What a great idea.
It is eaten with soy sauce and spicy seasoning.

Recently, I had a lot to go to Seongsu Station, so I kept using Seongsu Station, but I never once passed by it.
